{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 3: Convert assay_batch B biomarker_final from µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup["assay_batch"] == 'B', "biomarker_final"] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute overall response rates by arm (no stratification, as per contract)
treatment_responded = df_dedup[(df_dedup["arm"] == "treatment") & (df_dedup["responded"] == 1)].shape[0]
treatment_total = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "treatment"].shape[0]
control_responded = df_dedup[(df_dedup["arm"] == "control") & (df_dedup["responded"] == 1)].shape[0]
control_total = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "control"].shape[0]

# Compute proportions
prop_treatment = treatment_responded / treatment_total
prop_control = control_responded / control_total

# Compute difference
treatment_effect = prop_treatment - prop_control

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of patients in treatment arm: {treatment_total}')
print(f'Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_responded}')
print(f'Proportion responded in treatment arm: {prop_treatment}')

print(f'Number of patients in control arm: {control_total}')
print(f'Number of responders in control arm: {control_responded}')
print(f'Proportion responded in control arm: {prop_control}')

print(f'Treatment effect (difference in proportions): {treatment_effect}')"}
